title: Anam - Tuatha na nGaelscoil
voiceover_lines: Welcome to Anam, Space 4 of 4. The integration Space. Five elements, seven features, one soulbound wallet.
Panel 1: Talamh, Earth - the curriculum map. Lifted from Space 1, summarised here for the integration demo.
Panel 2: Uisce, Water - the chemistry visual. Eight molecules, CPK colours, hand-drawn SVG.
Panel 3: Tine, Fire - the OCR forge. The Gaelscribhneoir checks fada, eclipsis, and punctum on a sample Irish text.
Panel 5: Anam, Spirit - the soulbound token. Three stages, five elements, one wallet. Click an element to record a feat.
Two feats and the Setanta stage advances to Cuchulainn. Five feats unlock the Riastrad, the warp spasm.
